description: This file defines the interface for the IShell component within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes class declarations, enums, and method signatures related to plugin lifecycle management, remote connection handling, and web server control.

classes.name: WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell
classes.description: Interface for controlling plugin lifecycle, remote connections, and web server management within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell::ICOMLink
classes.description: Interface for managing remote connections and instantiating COM objects in the main process.

classes.name: WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell::Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatch job to change the state of the plugin (activate/deactivate).

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a new Job instance for changing plugin state.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Executes the job, activating or deactivating the plugin based on the internal state.

methods.name: EnableWebServer
methods.description: Enables the web server for the plugin at a specified URL path and file system path.

methods.name: DisableWebServer
methods.description: Disables the web server for the plugin.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the hosting application.

methods.name: Major
methods.description: Returns the major version number.

methods.name: Minor
methods.description: Returns the minor version number.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Returns the patch version number.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Returns a human-readable model name of the platform.

methods.name: Background
methods.description: Indicates if the plugin host is running in daemon mode.

methods.name: Accessor
methods.description: Returns the identifier for connecting to the webbridge.

methods.name: WebPrefix
methods.description: Returns the web prefix used in URL routing.

methods.name: Locator
methods.description: Returns the name of the binary that contains the plugin code.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the plugin.

methods.name: Versions
methods.description: Returns a JSON array of supported interface versions.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the instantiation name of the plugin.

methods.name: PersistentPath
methods.description: Returns the persistent storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: VolatilePath
methods.description: Returns the volatile storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: DataPath
methods.description: Returns the data storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: ProxyStubPath
methods.description: Returns the path for proxy/stub files.

methods.name: SystemRootPath
methods.description: Returns the system root path.

methods.name: SystemRootPath (setter)
methods.description: Sets the system root path.

methods.name: Substitute
methods.description: Performs variable substitution in input string.

methods.name: AutoStart
methods.description: Indicates if the plugin should auto-start.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Indicates if the plugin should start in resumed state.

methods.name: HashKey
methods.description: Returns a hash key for the plugin.

methods.name: ConfigLine
methods.description: Returns or sets the plugin configuration line.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific version is supported.

methods.name: SubSystems
methods.description: Provides access to plugin subsystems.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Sends a notification message to subscribers.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current plugin state.

methods.name: QueryInterfaceByCallsign
methods.description: Queries for an interface by callsign.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the plugin.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Marks the plugin as unavailable.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates the plugin.

methods.name: Wakeup
methods.description: Wakes up the plugin from hibernation.

methods.name: Reason
methods.description: Returns the reason for the current plugin state change.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a JSON response to the main process.

methods.name: COMLink
methods.description: Provides access to the COM link interface.

methods.name: Register (inline)
methods.description: Registers a remote connection notification.

methods.name: Unregister (inline)
methods.description: Unregisters a remote connection notification.

methods.name: RemoteConnection
methods.description: Gets a remote connection by ID.

methods.name: EnablePersistentStorage
methods.description: Ensures persistent storage directory exists.
